modules.name: Harmonia (HRM)
modules.description: HARMONIC family: six additive harmonic voices with odd, even, partials, tilt, morph, harmonic lock and three pan locations.

modules.name: Trace (TRC)
modules.description: HARMONIC family: eight gestural CV recorders. Hold to record, release to loop; offset, attenuate, speed, slow-down, random phase, sub-loop.

modules.name: Nonet (NON)
modules.description: HARMONIC family: stereo effect with nine algorithms and three modes each: long delay, phasers, FDN reverbs, stretch flanger, grains, scanner.

modules.name: Tangle (TGL)
modules.description: ENTANGLE family: one stereo effects core, 4 banks of 16 programs, six pots and a button. Cores side by side entangle.

modules.name: Weave (WVE)
modules.description: ENTANGLE family: twelve coupled complex modulators, four voltage-controlled gates and a four-input pan mixer.

modules.name: Axiom (AXM)
modules.description: EQUATION family: ten equations making four polyrhythmic pulse channels with accent and pitch.

modules.name: Tetra (TET)
modules.description: EQUATION family: four 2-operator phase-modulation voices (W X Y Z), drum or voice mode, cross-modulation matrix.

modules.name: Cheb (CHB)
modules.description: EQUATION family: stereo Chebyshev (2nd kind) waveshaper with 40 predefined polynomials, scan and spread.
